title: Conventional drill depth and chip evacuation

source.agreement: Read 2026-11-08. Haas mill manual and Hannibal Drill Basics independently agree that conventional drills should peck beyond 3 diameters. This is the agreed threshold used here; specialised coolant-fed and inserted drills have different guidance. Haas distinguishes G73 small lifts from G83 complete exit and restricts high-speed pecking to through-tool coolant.
source.policy: Half-diameter constant increments are step2cam's conservative starting policy, not a universal manufacturer specification. Both intermediate and deep holes use full retract: the library cannot declare through-tool coolant. No universal 5D chip-break/full-retract boundary is asserted. A positive tool peck_mm caps the increment; zero/absent means no cap. At or below 3D a single plunge is used regardless of the cap. Depth is measured from stock top including requested breakthrough, excluding the drill point allowance.
